title: FSM Moore Output Registered One Cycle Late
description: The Moore FSM output is sampled from state registers but drives a downstream module that expects the output to reflect the current state, not the previous one.
bug_signature: UVM_ERROR: [SBD_DATA] Output valid late by 1 cycle relative to state entry
expected_root_cause: Moore output is registered in the same always_ff block as the state register, adding one extra pipeline stage [8, 12].
testbench: initial begin state_in = ACTIVE; @(posedge clk); assert(out_valid == 1); end
failure_log: T=10: state=ACTIVE. T=10+: out_valid=0 (one cycle late). Expected=1.
success_log: out_valid combinationally reflects state == ACTIVE on same cycle.
